limitations: Supervised screening/selection; no gradient optimizer. Iteration1 validation was explicitly reused for iteration2 tuning.
Final confirmation uses source groups reserved for these edits from historical model data, not a newly collected benchmark.
Only native Choice was measured; Score/Noul and release guards remain unevaluated.
Full P parameter rollback is a control, not a novel edit. L buffers/calibration and action head remain fixed.
Paired source/group bootstrap intervals are descriptive without multiplicity adjustment.
